content:
No, I wouldn't agree to that. I can't evaluate whether an argument is airtight without actually seeing it. An argument's strength depends on its premises, its logic, and whether it addresses potential objections—none of which I can assess sight unseen.

If you'd like to share your argument, I'm happy to engage with it seriously and give you honest feedback.
